existingReportSummary.executiveSummaryMd: `Invoice` has material local breaking changes. Top concerns: `date`→`creation`, `deduction` disappearing from required price-component terminology, and price components moving to `MonetaryComponent`; the largest uncertainty is whether the unconstrained R6 `lineItem.chargeItem[x]` Reference is intentional.
existingReportSummary.migrationThemesMd: Use explicit R4/R6 transforms. Rename posting date fields, map price-component terminology with business review, regenerate code for `MonetaryComponent`, and decide how R6-only `period[x]`, `serviced[x]`, Practitioner issuers, and non-ChargeItem references are handled on R4 export.
existingReportSummary.confidenceSummaryMd: High confidence for structural deltas because they come from primary local StructureDefinitions and complete CodeSystems. Medium confidence for rationale and prevalence because official diffs, narrative change notes, profiles, and instance corpus were unavailable.

compatibilityLeverage.note: Resource-level leverage is a planning signal. It does not mark individual Revisit findings as justified or unimportant.

rationaleMd:

R4 maturity context is trial-use/FMM 0, which creates weak stability pressure.

The computed migration-unavoidability score is 36/100, producing migration shape `moderate-targeted-remodel`, major migration `Partial`, and compatibility posture `preserve-where-low-cost-but-expect-resource-migration`.

topFindings.title: Invoice.date was renamed to Invoice.creation
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 instances with `date` contain an element not present in the R6 Invoice StructureDefinition; runtime/API/codegen also changes because the generated property name becomes `creation`.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Price component code `deduction` was removed from the required type binding
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: an R4 price component with `type` = `deduction` is outside the R6 required value set; runtime/API/codegen also changes because generated enum members and switch logic lose that code.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Invoice price components now use the shared MonetaryComponent datatype
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: runtime/API/codegen: generated nested classes and profile paths move from an Invoice-owned backbone to `MonetaryComponent`; old-valid/new-invalid occurs for R4 price components that actually use `modifierExtension`.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Invoice.lineItem.chargeItemReference no longer has a computable ChargeItem-only target profile
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: R6-to-R4 loss: R6 can now structurally carry non-ChargeItem references that R4 rejects; runtime/API/codegen risk arises when validators and billing code can no longer rely on a computable ChargeItem target.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Invoice.issuer can now reference Practitioner and PractitionerRole as well as Organization
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: R6-to-R4 loss: new R6 Practitioner or PractitionerRole issuers have no direct R4 base target, but R4 Organization issuers remain valid in R6.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: R6 adds Invoice.lineItem.serviced[x] for line-item service date or period
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: R6-to-R4 loss: R6 service timing at line level has no direct R4 base slot, but there is no R4-to-R6 instance or generated-property removal.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: R6 adds Invoice.period[x] for the billing date or period
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: R6-to-R4 loss: R6 `periodDate` or `periodPeriod` has no direct R4 base element, but there is no old-valid/new-invalid R4-to-R6 break.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.
